# apple_beta_license_agreement (Resource)

Manages the license agreement TestFlight testers accept before testing an app. App Store Connect creates it with the app and it cannot be deleted, so creating this resource manages the existing one and destroying the resource leaves the current settings in place. Import it by app ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "apple_beta_license_agreement" "example" {
  app_id         = data.apple_app.example.id
  agreement_text = file("${path.module}/beta-license.txt")
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `agreement_text` (String) Text of the license agreement.
- `app_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the app.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the license agreement.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = apple_beta_license_agreement.example
  identity = {
    app_id = "1234567890"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `app_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the app.

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import apple_beta_license_agreement.example 1234567890
```
